words: Who you approach first: Churn 30D, 14D, 7D, 3D, 1D, then Grace Period, then High P&L, then LTV. Strictly top down.
An inactive player, by days since last activity (1, 3, 7, 14 or 30 days).
The first-contact entry in the Customer Approaching File: date, username, brand, tier, reason. Follow-ups go underneath it as sub-records.
What happened after your message: Response Received, No Response, Deposit Made, or Referred to Livechat.
Telegram adds to Internal Mail and Livechat. It never replaces them.

tour.label: When
tour.title: Can you message this player now?
items: Every higher-priority player is already contacted
The player has a registered Telegram contact
You have not already sent a message this session without a reply
tour.done: All three: send one message, in the right tone for the segment.
tour.notYet: Work the higher priority first. No registered contact: skip. Already messaged: wait for a reply.

tour.label: Do
tour.title: Six steps
items: Open the Telegram section
Customer Approaching File, current month. Prior-month follow-ups: last month's file.
Work top down
Start at Priority 1 (Churn 30D) and move down to LTV.
Record the approach
First contact: New Approach record. Follow-up: a sub-record under it, never a duplicate.
Send one message
Check the registered contact. One message per session, right tone. No bonus talk.
Record the outcome
Right after sending. Replied on Livechat? Record the conversion and link it.
QA Record
End of shift: total approached and conversions.

tour.label: Never
tour.title: Four hard stops
items: Promise, imply or hint at any bonus on Telegram.
Skip to a lower priority while higher ones are uncontacted.
Send repeated messages. Players block you; wait for a reply.
Message a high-loss player the same day, while emotions are high.

tour.label: Scenarios
tour.title: Your goal by player type
items: Risk player
Get a reply, learn why they stopped, fix one issue. Same day the risk tier is detected.
Newly upgraded VVIP
Build the relationship, agree how they like to be contacted. Soon after the 2:00 PM list update.
High-loss player
Welfare check, take pressure off. Not to drive play. Next day at the earliest.
High deposit / LTV
White-glove care and trust, no push for bigger deposits. Weekly check-ins.

tour.label: Reply
tour.title: The player replied
tour.yes: Acknowledge it and reframe. Never say "win it back".
tour.no: Won: celebrate and guide gently. No reply: try a soft re-engagement later, no spam.

pool.q: Who do you approach first on Telegram?
pool.why: Work strictly top down: Churn 30D is Priority 1, LTV is last.

pool.q: Three Churn 7D players are uncontacted, but an LTV player looks promising. What now?
pool.why: Never approach a lower priority while higher-priority players are uncontacted.

pool.q: A player on Telegram asks, "Any bonus for me?" What do you say?
o: No promise or hint; talk about how you can help
pool.why: Never promise, imply or hint at any bonus on Telegram.

pool.q: You messaged a player 20 minutes ago with no reply. What now?
o: Wait for a reply before following up
Mark them No Response and send again
pool.why: One approach message per session. Repeated messages get you blocked.

pool.q: A player lost heavily an hour ago. When do you message them?
pool.why: High-loss players: wait until at least the next day. Never message while emotions are high.

pool.q: You follow up a player you approached last week. How do you record it?
o: A sub-record under the original entry
pool.why: Follow-ups are sub-records under the original entry. Do not duplicate the entry.

pool.q: A player replies, "I lost again today." Which reply fits?
o: Deposit again and win it back!
Sorry to hear that, boss. Want to take a break and try a lighter game later?
pool.why: Lost: acknowledge, reframe, never "win it back".

pool.q: Does Telegram replace Internal Mail and Livechat?
o: No, it is a supplementary channel
pool.why: Telegram is supplementary. It does not replace Internal Mail or Livechat.
